scope: Actual infinity chart-function image localization and its normalized adic valuation for every field/general Weierstrass model. Actual coefficient RingHom into the actual norm-degree DVR; actual chart image algebra generated by t=X/Y,z=1/Y. Derived finite-type Noetherian domain, unique/surjective origin evaluation with kernel exactly(t,z). Exact source chart relation makes bracket evaluate1 and become a unit after actual origin localization. Actual localized maximal ideal=(t), t nonzero, actual DVR derived with no DVR premise. Explicit injective localization map into norm-DVR; actual chart fraction-field surjectivity and actual full elliptic FunctionField fraction-ring identifications proved, not assumed. Actual DVR factorization and valuation bound give surjectivity; explicit RingEquiv commutes with actual function-field inclusion. Official normalized maximal-ideal adic valuation equals norm-degree valuation on every actual field element, deriving source-sign line/vertical pole orders -3/-2 and actual residue-one normalization. Actual local residue field explicitly isomorphic to K with exact residue/evaluation formula. Reciprocal-X substitution makes normalized-line difference valuation1, failing correct strict normalization. Sixteen modules include seven byte-identical credited norm-valuation modules and nine new modules; defaults/standard foundations. This is the specified actual function-field chart-image localization, not an unproved Mathlib projective Scheme.localRing comparison. Full finite-point principal divisor/translation/Weil reciprocity/isogeny/Lang/Cartier/Jacobian/canonical Weil-Tate/MOV-FR/all14 remain open. No novelty/canonical promotion/independent physical-host/parser/compiler/signed-standing claim.
